## claude.ai Claude Docs
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{…}},"markdown":"# <title>

<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>

<?claude block s1?>

<?claude block s2?>"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: "<root id>"`.

## claude.ai Consensus
Consensus is a research paper search engine: relevance-ranked semantic search over 400M+ peer-reviewed papers (Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, PubMed). Use the `search` tool to look up papers for a scientific query; it takes plain-language queries and returns ranked paper records. When presenting search results, you MUST cite papers inline using their numbered references from the tool result (e.g. [1], [2], [3]). When discussing findings, always attribute them to specific papers: 'Caffeine improves endurance performance [1] and reduces perceived exertion [3].' At the end of your response, list all cited papers as numbered references with their titles hyperlinked to the URLs from the tool result: [1] [Paper Title](url) (Authors, Year, Journal, Citations). Use the exact paper URLs from the tool result — do not modify, shorten, or regenerate them. Do not omit paper links or summarize results without citing specific papers. IMPORTANT: At the END of your response, you MUST include the sign-up, upgrade, or usage message from the tool result word-for-word. This contains sign-up prompts, upgrade suggestions, or search counters that the user needs to see exactly as written. Do not omit, shorten, or rephrase it. Batch at most 3 search calls at a time to avoid rate limits. If you receive a rate limit error, wait 30 seconds before retrying. Do NOT apply search filters (year_min, year_max, study_types, domain, human, sample_size_min, sjr_max, controlled, sjr_min, citation_min, open_access, country) unless the user explicitly requests them or clearly expresses intent to narrow results. If the user asks a research question without mentioning filtering criteria, call search with only the query parameter.

import json
from pathlib import Path

from v1.shared.patterns.worker_runtime import run_pipeline
from v1.workers.job_matcher import handler

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
LABELLED = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "labelled_sample.jsonl"
JOBS_RAW = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "jobs_raw.jsonl"
SEARCH_INPUTS = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "user_search_inputs"


@pytest.fixture
def labelled_data():
    if not LABELLED.exists():
        pytest.skip("data/labelled_sample.jsonl not present")
    return [json.loads(line) for line in LABELLED.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]


@pytest.fixture
def raw_jobs():
    if not JOBS_RAW.exists():
        pytest.skip("data/jobs_raw.jsonl not present")
    result = {}
    with JOBS_RAW.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.strip():
                row = json.loads(line)
                result[row["job_id"]] = row
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Labelled sample shape / content sanity checks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_labelled_sample_has_expected_shape(labelled_data):
    """Sanity check: 60 rows, each with decision/reason/matched_* fields."""
    assert len(labelled_data) == 60
    for row in labelled_data:
        assert "job_id" in row
        assert row["decision"] in ("yes", "no")
        assert "reason" in row


def test_labelled_yes_jobs_count(labelled_data):
    yes = [r for r in labelled_data if r["decision"] == "yes"]
    assert len(yes) == 11


def test_labelled_no_jobs_include_dead_links(labelled_data, raw_jobs):
    """8 of the 'no' labels are 404/410 jobs — documents the dead-link bug scope."""
    dead_nos = [
        label
        for label in labelled_data
        if label["decision"] == "no"
        and raw_jobs.get(label["job_id"], {}).get("page", {}).get("http_status") in (404, 410)
    ]
    assert len(dead_nos) >= 8


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Full pipeline integration: 1529-job feed against profile_a
# These numbers come from run 20261020T153054 and must stay stable.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _run_full_pipeline(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> set[str]:
    """Helper: run v1 on jobs_raw.jsonl vs profile_a, return matched job_id set."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("ILLUMINI_RUNS_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    if not JOBS_RAW.exists() or not SEARCH_INPUTS.exists():
        pytest.skip("data/ files not present")
    outputs = run_pipeline(
        handler.STAGE_GRAPH,
        handler.INPUT_CONTEXT_SCHEMA,
        handler.OUTPUT_CONTEXT_SCHEMA,
        handler.HANDLER_NAME,
        JOBS_RAW,
        SEARCH_INPUTS,
    )
    matched: set[str] = set()
    for path in outputs:
        for line in Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            if line.strip():
                matched.add(json.loads(line)["job_id"])
    return matched


def test_v1_full_pipeline_output_count(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

    matched = _run_full_pipeline(tmp_path, monkeypatch)

Requires a live LLM API key (ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY or GEMINI_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY).
Skipped automatically in CI / environments without a key.

Target: recall ≥ 8/11 YES jobs, 0 false positives on NO jobs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

LABELLED_PATH = Path("data/labelled_sample.jsonl")
JOBS_PATH = Path("data/jobs_raw.jsonl")
SEARCH_INPUTS = Path("data/user_search_inputs")

_has_llm_key = bool(
    os.environ.get("ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY")
    or os.environ.get("GEMINI_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY")
    or (
        Path(".env").exists()
        and any(
            k in Path(".env").read_text() for k in ("ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "GEMINI_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY")
        )
    )
)
pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not _has_llm_key, reason="No LLM API key — set ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY")

KNOWN_MISSES = {"J576140", "J229510", "J809819"}


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def pipeline_results(tmp_path_factory):
    """Run v2 pipeline once; return {job_id: matched_row} for all matches."""
    tmp = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("run")
    import os

    os.environ["ILLUMINI_RUNS_DIR"] = str(tmp)
    from v2.workers.job_matcher.handler import run_parallel_pipeline

    run_parallel_pipeline(JOBS_PATH, SEARCH_INPUTS)

    matched: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for jl in tmp.glob("*/*_matched.jsonl"):
        for line in jl.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            if line.strip():
                row = json.loads(line)
                matched[row["job_id"]] = row
    return matched


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def labelled():
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in LABELLED_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
    yes = {r["job_id"] for r in rows if r.get("matched_company")}
    no = {r["job_id"] for r in rows if not r.get("matched_company")}
    return yes, no


def test_recall_at_least_8_of_11(pipeline_results, labelled):
    yes_ids, _ = labelled
    hits = yes_ids & pipeline_results.keys()
    assert len(hits) >= 8, f"Recall {len(hits)}/{len(yes_ids)}; misses: {sorted(yes_ids - pipeline_results.keys())}"


def test_no_false_positives(pipeline_results, labelled):
    _, no_ids = labelled
    fp = no_ids & pipeline_results.keys()
    assert fp == set(), f"False positives: {sorted(fp)}"


def test_matched_fields_present(pipeline_results, labelled):
    yes_ids, _ = labelled
    hits = yes_ids & pipeline_results.keys()
    for jid in hits:
        row = pipeline_results[jid]
        assert row.get("matched_company"), f"{jid}: missing matched_company"

        assert row.get("matched_location"), f"{jid}: missing matched_location"
        assert row.get("profile_id") == "a", f"{jid}: wrong profile_id"

"""v2 job matcher handler — parallel chunked pipeline."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from v2.shared.api_calls import llm
from v2.shared.patterns.logging import get_logger, log_event
from v2.shared.patterns.worker_runtime import (
    DEFAULT_JOBS,
    DEFAULT_SEARCH_INPUTS,
    load_search_inputs,
    new_trace_id,
    run_dir,
    validate_context,
)
from v2.shared.schemas.job_matcher.v1 import JOB_MATCHER_SCHEMA as OUTPUT_CONTEXT_SCHEMA
from v2.shared.schemas.pipeline_start_takehome.v1 import PIPELINE_START_TAKEHOME_SCHEMA as INPUT_CONTEXT_SCHEMA

HANDLER_NAME = "job_matcher"
VERSION = "v2.0.0"


def run_parallel_pipeline(jobs_path: Path, search_inputs_dir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Load all jobs once, run parallel normalization+agent per recruiter, then output."""
    trace_id = new_trace_id()
    logger = get_logger(HANDLER_NAME)
    rd = run_dir(trace_id)
    llm.start_run(rd)
    log_event(logger, "info", "run_started", trace_id, jobs_path=str(jobs_path))

    stage_clean_jobs = importlib.import_module("v2.workers.job_matcher.stages.stage_clean_jobs")
    stage_output = importlib.import_module("v2.workers.job_matcher.stages.stage_output")
    stage_report = importlib.import_module("v2.workers.job_matcher.stages.stage_report")
    chunk_runner = importlib.import_module("v2.workers.job_matcher.chunk_runner")

    outputs: dict[str, str] = {}
    for prefix, profile in load_search_inputs(Path(search_inputs_dir)):
        context = {
            "trace_id": trace_id,
            "jobs_path": str(jobs_path),
            "profile": profile,
            "profile_id": profile["profile_id"],
            "output_prefix": prefix,
        }
        validate_context(context, INPUT_CONTEXT_SCHEMA)

        # Stage 1: load
        load_result = stage_clean_jobs.main(context, [])
        all_rows = load_result.data

        # Stages 2+3: normalize + agent in parallel chunks
        matched = chunk_runner.run_chunks(all_rows, context)

        # Stage 4: output
        output_result = stage_output.main(context, matched)
        context.update(output_result.artifacts)

        validate_context(context, OUTPUT_CONTEXT_SCHEMA)
        outputs[context["output_path"]] = str(len(output_result.data))

    # Stage 5: report (per run, after all profiles)
    report_context = {"trace_id": trace_id, "runs_dir": str(rd)}
    stage_report.main(report_context, [])

    log_event(logger, "info", "run_finished", trace_id, outputs=outputs,
              llm_spent_gbp=round(llm.spent_gbp(), 4))  # fmt: skip
    return outputs


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=HANDLER_NAME)
    parser.add_argument("--jobs", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_JOBS)
    parser.add_argument("--search-inputs", "--briefs", dest="search_inputs",
                        type=Path, default=DEFAULT_SEARCH_INPUTS)  # fmt: skip
    args, _ = parser.parse_known_args()
    for path, count in run_parallel_pipeline(args.jobs, args.search_inputs).items():
        print(f"{count:>5} matches -> {path}")
    sys.exit(0)

"""LLM agent: decide which jobs match the recruiter profile (company × title × location)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time

import pydantic

from v2.shared.api_calls.llm import ask_pydantic
from v2.shared.observability.sli_observe import passed, reject, sli_observe
from v2.shared.patterns.logging import get_logger, log_event
from v2.shared.patterns.worker_runtime import ExecutionResult

MODULE_NAME = "job_matcher__match_jobs"
MODULE_TYPE = "filter"
REJECTION_REASONS = {"NO_MATCH"}
ERROR_REASONS = {"LLM_ERROR"}
WARNING_REASONS: set[str] = set()

BATCH_SIZE = 10


class _JobResult(pydantic.BaseModel):
    job_id: str
    match: bool
    matched_company: str
    matched_job_title: list[str]
    matched_location: list[str]
    reason: str


class _BatchResults(pydantic.BaseModel):
    results: list[_JobResult]


def _profile_prompt(profile: dict) -> str:
    companies = [c["name"] if isinstance(c, dict) else c for c in profile.get("companies") or []]
    titles = profile.get("titles") or []
    locs = profile.get("locations") or []

    loc_lines = []
    for loc in locs:
        inc = ", ".join(loc.get("includes") or [])
        loc_lines.append(f"  - {loc['name']} ({loc['type']}){': includes ' + inc if inc else ''}")

    return (
        f"TARGET COMPANIES ({len(companies)}):\n"
        + ", ".join(companies)
        + f"\n\nTARGET JOB TITLES ({len(titles)}):\n"
        + ", ".join(str(t) for t in titles)
        + f"\n\nTARGET LOCATIONS ({len(locs)}):\n"
        + "\n".join(loc_lines)
    )


def _job_prompt(row: dict) -> dict:
    page = row.get("page") or {}
    sj = page.get("structured_job") or {}
    return {
        "job_id": row.get("job_id", ""),
        "company": row.get("resolved_company") or row.get("company") or sj.get("company") or "",
        "title": row.get("resolved_title") or row.get("title") or sj.get("title") or "",
        "location_strings": row.get("location_strings") or [],
        "is_remote": bool(row.get("is_remote_hint")),
        "title_tag": (page.get("title_tag") or "")[:120],
    }


def _build_prompt(profile_text: str, jobs: list[dict]) -> str:
    return f"""You are a job matching assistant. Evaluate each job against the recruiter's profile.
            A job MATCHES only when ALL THREE pass:
            1. COMPANY: The company on the job page is one of the target companies.
            Match ignores case, punctuation, legal suffixes (Ltd, plc, Group, Holdings, Corp, UK), and a leading "The".
            2. TITLE: Every word from a target job title appears in the job title
            (any order, case-insensitive; treat trailing "s" as plural).
            3. LOCATION: Job location is in one of the target locations.
            - city/sub_region: job must be in that city or any of its includes list.
            - remote: job must declare remote/home-based work.
            - Jobs in a different country never match.

            {profile_text}

            JOBS TO EVALUATE:
            {json.dumps(jobs, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

            For each job return:
            - job_id: same as input
            - match: true if all three pass, false otherwise
            - matched_company: the matching profile company name (empty string if no match)
            - matched_job_title: list of ALL matching profile titles (empty if no match)
            - matched_location: list of ALL matching profile location names (empty if no match)
            - reason: one sentence explaining the decision"""


def main(context: dict, prev_data: list[dict]) -> ExecutionResult:
    trace_id: str = context.get("trace_id") or ""
    start_time = time.time()
    logger = get_logger(MODULE_NAME)

    profile = context["profile"]
    profile_text = _profile_prompt(profile)

    idx: dict[str, dict] = {r["job_id"]: r for r in prev_data}

    for i in range(0, len(prev_data), BATCH_SIZE):
        batch = prev_data[i : i + BATCH_SIZE]
        try:
            prompt = _build_prompt(profile_text, [_job_prompt(r) for r in batch])
            llm_results = ask_pydantic(prompt, _BatchResults, purpose="job_matching").results
        except Exception as exc:
            log_event(logger, "error", "llm_batch_failed", trace_id, error=str(exc), batch_start=i)
            for row in batch:
                row["META_ERROR_REASON"] = "LLM_ERROR"
            continue

        for res in llm_results:
            row = idx.get(res.job_id)
            if row is None:
                continue
            if res.match:
                row["matched_company"] = res.matched_company
                row["matched_job_title"] = res.matched_job_title
                row["matched_location"] = res.matched_location
                row["reason"] = res.reason
                row["used_llm"] = True
            else:
                reject(row, "NO_MATCH")

    sli_observe(prev_data, MODULE_NAME, start_time, trace_id)
    return ExecutionResult(
        trace_id=trace_id,
        script_span_id=f"{MODULE_NAME}_{trace_id}",
        data=passed(prev_data),
        artifacts={},
        metrics={},
    )

import os

JOBS_PATH = GOLDEN / "jobs.jsonl"

    or (

        and any(
            k in Path(".env").read_text()
            for k in ("ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "GEMINI_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY")
        )
    )
)
pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not _has_llm_key, reason="No LLM API key — set ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY")

"""The ONE way this codebase calls an LLM. Budget £1 for the whole task; hard stop at £3.00.

    from v2.shared.api_calls.llm import ask, ask_json, ask_pydantic, BudgetExceeded
    summary = ask("Summarise this job title in three words: ...", purpose="title_summary")
    data = ask_json("...", schema={"type": "object", "properties": {...}, "required": [...],
                                   "additionalProperties": False}, purpose="...")
    result = ask_pydantic("...", output_type=MyModel, purpose="...")  # typesafe-ai/jev via AI Gateway

Provider: Anthropic if ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY is set, else Gemini (GEMINI_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY).
ask_pydantic uses typesafe-ai/jev via Vercel AI Gateway (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY in .env.local).
Every call is logged to runs/<run>/llm_calls.jsonl (tokens, cost, your `purpose`). Spend is summed across
EVERY run folder. Before each call the worst case (prompt + max_tokens) is added to the total; if that
would pass £3.00, BudgetExceeded is raised and nothing is sent. There is no override.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, TypeVar

import ai
import pydantic

BUDGET_GBP = 3.00  # hard stop; the task budget is £1 (spend above it is questioned)
USD_TO_GBP = 0.79
DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 500
CHARS_PER_TOKEN_WORST_CASE = 2.5  # conservative: real English is ~4 chars per token
PROVIDERS: dict[str, dict] = {
    # USD per million tokens. Thinking tokens are billed as output.
    "anthropic": {"key": "ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "model": "claude-opus-5-5", "in": 4.00, "out": 20.00},
    "gemini": {"key": "GEMINI_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "model": "gemini-3.5-flash", "in": 0.30, "out": 2.50},
    "jev": {"key": "JEV_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "model": "typesafe-ai/jev", "in": 0.0, "out": 0.0},
}

_T = TypeVar("_T", bound=pydantic.BaseModel)

_run_dir: Path | None = None
_clients: dict[str, object] = {}
_budget_lock = threading.Lock()


class BudgetExceeded(RuntimeError):
    """The £3.00 hard stop would be passed. Nothing was sent."""


def start_run(run_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Called by the handler: this run's calls are logged in run_dir/llm_calls.jsonl."""
    global _run_dir
    _run_dir = run_dir


def _runs_root() -> Path:
    return Path(os.environ.get("ILLUMINI_RUNS_DIR", "runs"))


def spent_gbp() -> float:
    """Total spend so far, across every run folder."""
    total = 0.0
    for ledger in _runs_root().glob("*/llm_calls.jsonl"):
        with ledger.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
            total += sum(json.loads(line)["cost_gbp"] for line in f if line.strip())
    return total


def _load_env(path: Path = Path(".env")) -> None:
    """KEY=value lines from .env into the environment (values already set in the shell win)."""
    if path.exists():
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
            if sep and not key.strip().startswith("#"):
                os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip('"'))


def provider() -> str:
    """'anthropic' if its key is set (shell or .env), else 'gemini'. Skips jev (structured-output only)."""
    _load_env()
    for name, spec in PROVIDERS.items():
        if os.environ.get(spec["key"]):
            return name
    raise RuntimeError("No LLM key: set ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY or GEMINI_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY in .env")


def cost_gbp(name: str, prompt_tokens: int, completion_tokens: int) -> float:
    spec = PROVIDERS[name]
    return (prompt_tokens * spec["in"] + completion_tokens * spec["out"]) / 1_000_000 * USD_TO_GBP


def _guard(name: str, prompt: str, max_tokens: int) -> float:
    """Raise BudgetExceeded unless the worst case of this call still fits under £3.00. Returns spend so far."""
    total = spent_gbp()
    worst = cost_gbp(name, int(len(prompt) / CHARS_PER_TOKEN_WORST_CASE) + 1, max_tokens)
    if total + worst > BUDGET_GBP:
        raise BudgetExceeded(
            f"LLM budget: £{total:.4f} spent, this call could cost up to £{worst:.4f}, cap £{BUDGET_GBP:.2f}"
        )
    return total


async def _send_jev_async(prompt: str, output_type: type[_T]) -> tuple[_T, int, int, str]:
    messages = [ai.user_message(prompt)]
    async with ai.stream(ai.get_model(PROVIDERS["jev"]["model"]), messages, output_type=output_type) as stream:
        async for _ in stream:
            pass
    usage = stream.usage
    return (
        stream.output,
        usage.input_tokens if usage else 0,
        usage.output_tokens if usage else 0,
        "end_turn",
    )


def _send(
    name: str, prompt: str, max_tokens: int, schema: dict | None, output_type: type | None = None
) -> tuple[Any, int, int, str]:
    """One provider call -> (result, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, stop_reason)."""
    spec = PROVIDERS[name]
    if name == "jev":
        return asyncio.run(_send_jev_async(prompt, output_type))
    if name == "anthropic":
        import anthropic

        client = _clients.setdefault(name, anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.environ[spec["key"]]))
        output_config: dict = {"effort": "low"}
        if schema:
            output_config["format"] = {"type": "json_schema", "schema": schema}
        response = client.messages.create(
            model=spec["model"],
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            output_config=output_config,
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        )
        text = "".join(block.text for block in response.content if block.type == "text")
        return text, response.usage.input_tokens, response.usage.output_tokens, str(response.stop_reason)
    from google import genai
    from google.genai import types

    client = _clients.setdefault(name, genai.Client(api_key=os.environ[spec["key"]]))
    config = types.GenerateContentConfig(
        max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
        temperature=0.0,
        thinking_config=types.ThinkingConfig(thinking_budget=0),
        **({"response_mime_type": "application/json", "response_json_schema": schema} if schema else {}),
    )
    response = client.models.generate_content(model=spec["model"], contents=prompt, config=config)
    usage = response.usage_metadata
    completion = (usage.candidates_token_count or 0) + (usage.thoughts_token_count or 0)
    finish = response.candidates[0].finish_reason if response.candidates else None
    return response.text or "", usage.prompt_token_count or 0, completion, str(finish)


def _call(prompt: str, max_tokens: int, purpose: str, schema: dict | None, output_type: type | None = None) -> Any:
    if output_type is not None:
        name = "jev"
        _load_env()
    else:
        name = provider()
    with _budget_lock:
        total = _guard(name, prompt, max_tokens)
    started = time.time()
    # API call is outside the lock — it's I/O-bound and the GIL releases
    result, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, stop_reason = _send(name, prompt, max_tokens, schema, output_type)
    cost = cost_gbp(name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens)
    rd = _run_dir or (_runs_root() / time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", time.gmtime(started)))
    rd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with _budget_lock:
        with (rd / "llm_calls.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "ts": round(started, 3),
                        "provider": name,
                        "model": PROVIDERS[name]["model"],
                        "purpose": purpose,
                        "prompt_tokens": prompt_tokens,
                        "completion_tokens": completion_tokens,
                        "cost_gbp": round(cost, 6),
                        "total_gbp": round(total + cost, 6),
                        "stop_reason": stop_reason,
                        "latency_ms": round((time.time() - started) * 1000),
                    }
                )
                + "\n"
            )
    return result if output_type is not None else result.strip()


def ask(prompt: str, max_tokens: int = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, purpose: str = "") -> str:
    """Send one prompt, get the text reply. `purpose` is logged so the spend can be read back."""
    return _call(prompt, max_tokens, purpose, None)


def ask_json(prompt: str, schema: dict, max_tokens: int = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, purpose: str = "") -> dict:
    """Send one prompt, get a dict that matches `schema` (a JSON Schema object with additionalProperties false)."""
    return json.loads(_call(prompt, max_tokens, purpose, schema))


def ask_pydantic(prompt: str, output_type: type[_T], purpose: str = "") -> _T:
    """Send one prompt to typesafe-ai/jev via Vercel AI Gateway, get a validated Pydantic model back."""
    return _call(prompt, DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, purpose, None, output_type)  # type: ignore[return-value]

async def _send_jev_async(prompt: str, output_type: type[_T]) -> tuple[_T, int, int, str]:
    messages = [ai.user_message(prompt)]
    async with ai.stream(ai.get_model(PROVIDERS["jev"]["model"]), messages, output_type=output_type) as stream:
        async for _ in stream:
            pass
    usage = stream.usage
    return (
        stream.output,
        usage.input_tokens if usage else 0,
        usage.output_tokens if usage else 0,
        "end_turn",
    )


def _send(
    name: str, prompt: str, max_tokens: int, schema: dict | None, output_type: type | None = None
) -> tuple[Any, int, int, str]:
    """One provider call -> (result, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, stop_reason)."""
    spec = PROVIDERS[name]
    if name == "jev":
        return asyncio.run(_send_jev_async(prompt, output_type))
    if name == "anthropic":
        import anthropic

        client = _clients.setdefault(name, anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.environ[spec["key"]]))
        output_config: dict = {"effort": "low"}
        if schema:
            output_config["format"] = {"type": "json_schema", "schema": schema}
        response = client.messages.create(
            model=spec["model"],
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            output_config=output_config,
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        )
        text = "".join(block.text for block in response.content if block.type == "text")
        return text, response.usage.input_tokens, response.usage.output_tokens, str(response.stop_reason)
    from google import genai
    from google.genai import types

    client = _clients.setdefault(name, genai.Client(api_key=os.environ[spec["key"]]))
    config = types.GenerateContentConfig(
        max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
        temperature=0.0,
        thinking_config=types.ThinkingConfig(thinking_budget=0),
        **({"response_mime_type": "application/json", "response_json_schema": schema} if schema else {}),
    )
    response = client.models.generate_content(model=spec["model"], contents=prompt, config=config)
    usage = response.usage_metadata
    completion = (usage.candidates_token_count or 0) + (usage.thoughts_token_count or 0)
    finish = response.candidates[0].finish_reason if response.candidates else None
    return response.text or "", usage.prompt_token_count or 0, completion, str(finish)


def _call(prompt: str, max_tokens: int, purpose: str, schema: dict | None, output_type: type | None = None) -> Any:
    if output_type is not None:
        name = "jev"
        _load_env()
    else:
        name = provider()
    with _budget_lock:
        total = _guard(name, prompt, max_tokens)
    started = time.time()
    # API call is outside the lock — it's I/O-bound and the GIL releases
    result, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, stop_reason = _send(name, prompt, max_tokens, schema, output_type)
    cost = cost_gbp(name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens)
    rd = _run_dir or (_runs_root() / time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", time.gmtime(started)))
    rd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with _budget_lock:
        with (rd / "llm_calls.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "ts": round(started, 3),
                        "provider": name,
                        "model": PROVIDERS[name]["model"],
                        "purpose": purpose,
                        "prompt_tokens": prompt_tokens,
                        "completion_tokens": completion_tokens,
                        "cost_gbp": round(cost, 6),
                        "total_gbp": round(total + cost, 6),
                        "stop_reason": stop_reason,
                        "latency_ms": round((time.time() - started) * 1000),
                    }
                )
                + "\n"
            )
    return result if output_type is not None else result.strip()


def ask(prompt: str, max_tokens: int = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, purpose: str = "") -> str:
    """Send one prompt, get the text reply. `purpose` is logged so the spend can be read back."""
    return _call(prompt, max_tokens, purpose, None)


def ask_json(prompt: str, schema: dict, max_tokens: int = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, purpose: str = "") -> dict:
    """Send one prompt, get a dict that matches `schema` (a JSON Schema object with additionalProperties false)."""
    return json.loads(_call(prompt, max_tokens, purpose, schema))


def ask_pydantic(prompt: str, output_type: type[_T], purpose: str = "") -> _T:
    """Send one prompt to typesafe-ai/jev via Vercel AI Gateway, get a validated Pydantic model back."""
    return _call(prompt, DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, purpose, None, output_type)  # type: ignore[return-value]

content.content:
"""JevEval: a score metric whose decision points are answered by TypeSafe AI's
System One model (Jev) with calibrated probabilities, never generated text.

The user defines the decision points as ``Noul`` / ``Score`` / ``Choice``
questions. DeepEval sends them to Jev in one ``decide()`` call, maps each
answer onto ``[0, 1]`` and takes a weighted mean. No LLM is involved at any
point: the reason is deterministic text built from Jev's answers and their
confidence.
"""

import asyncio
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence, Union

from deepeval.metrics import BaseMetric
from deepeval.metrics.indicator import metric_progress_indicator
from deepeval.metrics.utils import (
    accrue_token_usage,
    check_llm_test_case_params,
    construct_verbose_logs,
    format_system_one_reason,
)
from deepeval.models import DeepEvalBaseSystemOneModel
from deepeval.test_case import LLMTestCase, SingleTurnParams
from deepeval.utils import get_or_create_event_loop
from deepeval.config.settings import get_settings

from .questions import JevQuestion, QuestionOutcome
from .utils import (
    aggregate,
    aggregate_strict,
    build_questions,
    construct_single_turn_state,
    format_outcomes_for_logs,
    initialize_jev_model,
    mark_strict,
    min_confidence,
    outcomes_from_answers,
    validate_questions,
)


class JevEval(BaseMetric):
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        evaluation_params: Optional[List[SingleTurnParams]] = None,
        questions: Optional[Sequence[JevQuestion]] = None,
        system_one_model: Optional[
            Union[str, DeepEvalBaseSystemOneModel]
        ] = None,
        include_reason: bool = True,
        threshold: Optional[float] = 0.5,
        strict_mode: bool = False,
        async_mode: bool = True,
        verbose_mode: bool = False,
        flaky: bool = False,
        _include_jev_eval_suffix: bool = True,
    ):
        if not evaluation_params:
            raise ValueError(
                "evaluation_params cannot be empty; list the test case fields "
                "your questions refer to."
            )
        self.name = name
        self.evaluation_params = list(evaluation_params)
        self.questions = validate_questions(questions)
        self.system_one_model = initialize_jev_model(system_one_model)
        self.include_reason = include_reason
        self.evaluation_model = self.system_one_model.get_model_name()
        self.strict_mode = strict_mode
        self.threshold = 1 if strict_mode else threshold
        self.async_mode = async_mode
        self.verbose_mode = verbose_mode
        self.flaky = flaky
        self._include_jev_eval_suffix = _include_jev_eval_suffix
        self.score_breakdown: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None
        self.confidence: Optional[float] = None

    ###############################################
    # Measure
    ###############################################

    def _check_params(self, test_case: LLMTestCase) -> None:
        if test_case.multimodal:
            raise ValueError(
                f"{self.__name__} evaluates text only: Jev has no image "
                "input. Pass a text-only LLMTestCase."
            )
        check_llm_test_case_params(
            test_case,
            self.evaluation_params,
            None,
            None,

class EvaluationCost(float):
    """A generation cost (USD) that also carries the input/output token counts
    that produced it.

    It subclasses ``float``, so it behaves exactly like the plain cost float for
    every existing call site (``output, cost = model.generate(...)``,
    ``metric._accrue_cost(cost)``, arithmetic, comparisons). New code can read
    ``cost.input_tokens`` / ``cost.output_tokens`` to surface token usage
    e.g. for metric-run token visibility, without changing any return
    signatures. Token data rides along the returned value, so it stays correct
    under concurrent async fan-out (no shared model-instance state).

    Providers that have not yet been updated simply return a plain ``float``;
    readers fall back to ``None`` tokens via ``getattr(cost, "input_tokens",
    None)``, so adoption can be incremental.
    """

    input_tokens: Optional[int]
    output_tokens: Optional[int]

    def __new__(
        cls,
        value: Optional[float],
        input_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
        output_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> "EvaluationCost":
        obj = super().__new__(cls, value if value is not None else 0.0)
        obj.value = value
        obj.input_tokens = input_tokens
        obj.output_tokens = output_tokens
        return obj


def parse_model_name(model_name: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
    """Extract base model name from provider-prefixed format.

    This function is useful for extracting the actual model name from a
    provider-prefixed format which is used by some proxies like LiteLLM.
    LiteLLM is designed to work with many different LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic,
    Cohere, etc.). To tell it which provider's API to call, you prepend the provider
    name to the model ID, in the form "<provider>/<model>". So openai/gpt-4.1-mini
    literally means "OpenAI's GPT-4.1 Mini via the OpenAI chat completions endpoint."

    Args:
        model_name: Original model identifier, potentially in
            "<provider>/<model>" format

"""The ONE way this codebase calls an LLM — TypeSafe AI jev (System One decision model).

Usage:
    from v2.shared.api_calls.llm import decide, NoulQuestion, ChoiceQuestion, BudgetExceeded

    answers = decide(
        state={"title": "Controls Engineer", "company": "Siemens Energy", ...},
        questions={
            "company_match": NoulQuestion(instructions="Does this job belong to one of the target companies?"),
            "title_match":   NoulQuestion(instructions="Does the job title match one of the target titles?"),
            "location":      ChoiceQuestion(instructions="Which location?", options={"wigan": "Wigan", "none": "None"}),
        },
        purpose="job_matching",
    )
    answers.nouls["company_match"].probability   # float [0, 1]
    answers.choices["location"].choice           # e.g. "wigan"

Provider: TypeSafe AI jev-latest (JEV_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY in .env).
Every call is logged to runs/<run>/llm_calls.jsonl (tokens, GBP cost, purpose).
Hard stop at £3.00 (BudgetExceeded raised before sending).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from deepeval.models.system_one.schema import (  # re-exported for callers
    ChoiceQuestion,
    NoulQuestion,
    ScoreQuestion,
    SystemOneAnswers,
    SystemOneQuestion,
)

BUDGET_GBP = 3.00
USD_TO_GBP = 0.79
_JEV_INPUT_PRICE_USD_PER_M = 0.042  # output tokens are free

_run_dir: Path | None = None
_budget_lock = threading.Lock()
_model: Any = None


class BudgetExceeded(RuntimeError):
    """The £3.00 hard stop would be passed. Nothing was sent."""


def start_run(run_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Called by the handler: this run's calls are logged in run_dir/llm_calls.jsonl."""
    global _run_dir
    _run_dir = run_dir


def _runs_root() -> Path:
    return Path(os.environ.get("ILLUMINI_RUNS_DIR", "runs"))


def spent_gbp() -> float:
    """Total jev spend so far, across every run folder."""
    total = 0.0
    for ledger in _runs_root().glob("*/llm_calls.jsonl"):
        with ledger.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
            total += sum(json.loads(line)["cost_gbp"] for line in f if line.strip())
    return total


def _load_env(path: Path = Path(".env")) -> None:
    if path.exists():
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
            if sep and not key.strip().startswith("#"):
                os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip('"'))


def _api_key() -> str:
    _load_env()
    key = os.environ.get("JEV_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "")
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("No jev key: set JEV_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY in .env")
    return key


def _get_model() -> Any:
    global _model
    if _model is None:
        from deepeval.models.system_one.typesafe_model import TypeSafeModel
        _model = TypeSafeModel(api_key=_api_key())
    return _model


def _cost_gbp(input_tokens: int) -> float:
    return input_tokens * _JEV_INPUT_PRICE_USD_PER_M / 1_000_000 * USD_TO_GBP


def _estimate_tokens(state: dict, questions: dict) -> int:
    state_chars = sum(len(str(v)) for v in state.values())
    question_chars = sum(len(str(q)) for q in questions.values())
    return (state_chars + question_chars) // 4


def _guard(estimated_tokens: int) -> float:
    total = spent_gbp()
    worst = _cost_gbp(estimated_tokens)
    if total + worst > BUDGET_GBP:
        raise BudgetExceeded(
            f"LLM budget: £{total:.4f} spent, this call ~£{worst:.4f}, cap £{BUDGET_GBP:.2f}"
        )
    return total


def decide(
    state: dict[str, Any],
    questions: dict[str, SystemOneQuestion],
    purpose: str = "",
) -> SystemOneAnswers:
    """Ask jev to answer structured questions about `state`. Returns SystemOneAnswers.

    answers.nouls["key"].probability  → float [0, 1]
    answers.choices["key"].choice     → str option key
    answers.scores["key"].score       → float
    """
    estimated = _estimate_tokens(state, questions)
    with _budget_lock:
        total = _guard(estimated)

    started = time.time()
    answers, cost_obj = _get_model().decide(state, questions)

    input_tokens = getattr(cost_obj, "input_tokens", None) or estimated
    cost = _cost_gbp(input_tokens)

    rd = _run_dir or (_runs_root() / time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", time.gmtime(started)))
    rd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with _budget_lock:
        with (rd / "llm_calls.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(
                json.dumps({
                    "ts": round(started, 3),
                    "provider": "jev",
                    "model": "jev-latest",
                    "purpose": purpose,
                    "input_tokens": input_tokens,
                    "output_tokens": 0,
                    "cost_gbp": round(cost, 6),
                    "total_gbp": round(total + cost, 6),
                    "latency_ms": round((time.time() - started) * 1000),
                }) + "\n"
            )
    return answers

import asyncio

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, TypeVar

import ai
import pydantic

DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 500

    # USD per million tokens. Thinking tokens are billed as output.
    "anthropic": {"key": "ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "model": "claude-opus-5-5", "in": 4.00, "out": 20.00},
    "gemini": {"key": "GEMINI_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "model": "gemini-3.5-flash", "in": 0.30, "out": 2.50},
    "jev": {"key": "JEV_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "model": "typesafe-ai/jev", "in": 0.0, "out": 0.0},
}

_run_dir: Path | None = None
_clients: dict[str, object] = {}
_budget_lock = threading.Lock()


class BudgetExceeded(RuntimeError):
    """The £3.00 hard stop would be passed. Nothing was sent."""


def start_run(run_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Called by the handler: this run's calls are logged in run_dir/llm_calls.jsonl."""
    global _run_dir
    _run_dir = run_dir


def _runs_root() -> Path:
    return Path(os.environ.get("ILLUMINI_RUNS_DIR", "runs"))


def spent_gbp() -> float:
    """Total spend so far, across every run folder."""
    total = 0.0
    for ledger in _runs_root().glob("*/llm_calls.jsonl"):
        with ledger.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
            total += sum(json.loads(line)["cost_gbp"] for line in f if line.strip())
    return total


def _load_env(path: Path = Path(".env")) -> None:
    """KEY=value lines from .env into the environment (values already set in the shell win)."""
    if path.exists():
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
            if sep and not key.strip().startswith("#"):
                os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip('"'))


def provider() -> str:
    """'anthropic' if its key is set (shell or .env), else 'gemini'. Skips jev (structured-output only)."""
    _load_env()
    for name, spec in PROVIDERS.items():
        if os.environ.get(spec["key"]):
            return name
    raise RuntimeError("No LLM key: set ANTHROPIC_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY or GEMINI_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY in .env")


def cost_gbp(name: str, prompt_tokens: int, completion_tokens: int) -> float:
    spec = PROVIDERS[name]
    return (prompt_tokens * spec["in"] + completion_tokens * spec["out"]) / 1_000_000 * USD_TO_GBP


def _guard(name: str, prompt: str, max_tokens: int) -> float:
    """Raise BudgetExceeded unless the worst case of this call still fits under £3.00. Returns spend so far."""
    total = spent_gbp()
    worst = cost_gbp(name, int(len(prompt) / CHARS_PER_TOKEN_WORST_CASE) + 1, max_tokens)
    if total + worst > BUDGET_GBP:
        raise BudgetExceeded(
            f"LLM budget: £{total:.4f} spent, this call could cost up to £{worst:.4f}, cap £{BUDGET_GBP:.2f}"
        )
    return total


async def _send_jev_async(prompt: str, output_type: type[_T]) -> tuple[_T, int, int, str]:
    messages = [ai.user_message(prompt)]
    async with ai.stream(ai.get_model(PROVIDERS["jev"]["model"]), messages, output_type=output_type) as stream:
        async for _ in stream:
            pass
    usage = stream.usage
    return (
        stream.output,
        usage.input_tokens if usage else 0,
        usage.output_tokens if usage else 0,
        "end_turn",
    )


def _send(
    name: str, prompt: str, max_tokens: int, schema: dict | None, output_type: type | None = None
) -> tuple[Any, int, int, str]:
    """One provider call -> (result, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, stop_reason)."""
    spec = PROVIDERS[name]
    if name == "jev":
        jev_key = os.environ.get(spec["key"], "")
        os.environ.setdefault("AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY", jev_key)
        return asyncio.run(_send_jev_async(prompt, output_type))
    if name == "anthropic":
        import anthropic

        client = _clients.setdefault(name, anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=os.environ[spec["key"]]))
        output_config: dict = {"effort": "low"}
        if schema:
            output_config["format"] = {"type": "json_schema", "schema": schema}
        response = client.messages.create(
            model=spec["model"],
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            output_config=output_config,
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        )
        text = "".join(block.text for block in response.content if block.type == "text")
        return text, response.usage.input_tokens, response.usage.output_tokens, str(response.stop_reason)
    from google import genai
    from google.genai import types

    client = _clients.setdefault(name, genai.Client(api_key=os.environ[spec["key"]]))
    config = types.GenerateContentConfig(
        max_output_tokens=max_tokens,
        temperature=0.0,
        thinking_config=types.ThinkingConfig(thinking_budget=0),
        **({"response_mime_type": "application/json", "response_json_schema": schema} if schema else {}),
    )
    response = client.models.generate_content(model=spec["model"], contents=prompt, config=config)
    usage = response.usage_metadata
    completion = (usage.candidates_token_count or 0) + (usage.thoughts_token_count or 0)
    finish = response.candidates[0].finish_reason if response.candidates else None
    return response.text or "", usage.prompt_token_count or 0, completion, str(finish)


def _call(prompt: str, max_tokens: int, purpose: str, schema: dict | None, output_type: type | None = None) -> Any:
    if output_type is not None:
        name = "jev"
        _load_env()
    else:
        name = provider()
    with _budget_lock:
        total = _guard(name, prompt, max_tokens)
    started = time.time()
    # API call is outside the lock — it's I/O-bound and the GIL releases
    result, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, stop_reason = _send(name, prompt, max_tokens, schema, output_type)
    cost = cost_gbp(name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens)
    rd = _run_dir or (_runs_root() / time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", time.gmtime(started)))
    rd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with _budget_lock:
        with (rd / "llm_calls.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "ts": round(started, 3),
                        "provider": name,
                        "model": PROVIDERS[name]["model"],
                        "purpose": purpose,
                        "prompt_tokens": prompt_tokens,
                        "completion_tokens": completion_tokens,
                        "cost_gbp": round(cost, 6),
                        "total_gbp": round(total + cost, 6),
                        "stop_reason": stop_reason,
                        "latency_ms": round((time.time() - started) * 1000),
                    }
                )
                + "\n"
            )
    return result if output_type is not None else result.strip()


def ask(prompt: str, max_tokens: int = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, purpose: str = "") -> str:
    """Send one prompt, get the text reply. `purpose` is logged so the spend can be read back."""
    return _call(prompt, max_tokens, purpose, None)


def ask_json(prompt: str, schema: dict, max_tokens: int = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, purpose: str = "") -> dict:
    """Send one prompt, get a dict that matches `schema` (a JSON Schema object with additionalProperties false)."""
    return json.loads(_call(prompt, max_tokens, purpose, schema))


def ask_pydantic(prompt: str, output_type: type[_T], purpose: str = "") -> _T:
    """Send one prompt to typesafe-ai/jev via Vercel AI Gateway, get a validated Pydantic model back."""
    return _call(prompt, DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS, purpose, None, output_type)  # type: ignore[return-value]

"""LLM agent: decide which jobs match the recruiter profile (company × title × location)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time

import pydantic

from v2.shared.api_calls.llm import ask_pydantic
from v2.shared.observability.sli_observe import passed, reject, sli_observe
from v2.shared.patterns.logging import get_logger, log_event
from v2.shared.patterns.worker_runtime import ExecutionResult

MODULE_NAME = "job_matcher__match_jobs"
MODULE_TYPE = "filter"
REJECTION_REASONS = {"NO_MATCH"}
ERROR_REASONS = {"LLM_ERROR"}
WARNING_REASONS: set[str] = set()

BATCH_SIZE = 10


class _JobResult(pydantic.BaseModel):
    job_id: str
    match: bool
    matched_company: str
    matched_job_title: list[str]
    matched_location: list[str]
    reason: str


class _BatchResults(pydantic.BaseModel):
    results: list[_JobResult]


def _profile_prompt(profile: dict) -> str:
    companies = [c["name"] if isinstance(c, dict) else c for c in profile.get("companies") or []]
    titles = profile.get("titles") or []
    locs = profile.get("locations") or []

    loc_lines = []
    for loc in locs:
        inc = ", ".join(loc.get("includes") or [])
        loc_lines.append(f"  - {loc['name']} ({loc['type']}){': includes ' + inc if inc else ''}")

    return (
        f"TARGET COMPANIES ({len(companies)}):\n"
        + ", ".join(companies)
        + f"\n\nTARGET JOB TITLES ({len(titles)}):\n"
        + ", ".join(str(t) for t in titles)
        + f"\n\nTARGET LOCATIONS ({len(locs)}):\n"
        + "\n".join(loc_lines)
    )


def _job_prompt(row: dict) -> dict:
    page = row.get("page") or {}
    sj = page.get("structured_job") or {}
    return {
        "job_id": row.get("job_id", ""),
        "company": row.get("resolved_company") or row.get("company") or sj.get("company") or "",
        "title": row.get("resolved_title") or row.get("title") or sj.get("title") or "",
        "location_strings": row.get("location_strings") or [],
        "is_remote": bool(row.get("is_remote_hint")),
        "title_tag": (page.get("title_tag") or "")[:120],
    }


def _build_prompt(profile_text: str, jobs: list[dict]) -> str:
    return f"""You are a job matching assistant. Evaluate each job against the recruiter's profile.
            A job MATCHES only when ALL THREE pass:
            1. COMPANY: The company on the job page is one of the target companies.
            Match ignores case, punctuation, legal suffixes (Ltd, plc, Group, Holdings, Corp, UK), and a leading "The".
            2. TITLE: Every word from a target job title appears in the job title
            (any order, case-insensitive; treat trailing "s" as plural).
            3. LOCATION: Job location is in one of the target locations.
            - city/sub_region: job must be in that city or any of its includes list.
            - remote: job must declare remote/home-based work.
            - Jobs in a different country never match.

            {profile_text}

            JOBS TO EVALUATE:
            {json.dumps(jobs, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

            For each job return:
            - job_id: same as input
            - match: true if all three pass, false otherwise
            - matched_company: the matching profile company name (empty string if no match)
            - matched_job_title: list of ALL matching profile titles (empty if no match)
            - matched_location: list of ALL matching profile location names (empty if no match)
            - reason: one sentence explaining the decision"""


def main(context: dict, prev_data: list[dict]) -> ExecutionResult:
    trace_id: str = context.get("trace_id") or ""
    start_time = time.time()
    logger = get_logger(MODULE_NAME)

    profile = context["profile"]
    profile_text = _profile_prompt(profile)

    idx: dict[str, dict] = {r["job_id"]: r for r in prev_data}

    for i in range(0, len(prev_data), BATCH_SIZE):
        batch = prev_data[i : i + BATCH_SIZE]
        try:
            prompt = _build_prompt(profile_text, [_job_prompt(r) for r in batch])
            llm_results = ask_pydantic(prompt, _BatchResults, purpose="job_matching").results
        except Exception as exc:
            log_event(logger, "error", "llm_batch_failed", trace_id, error=str(exc), batch_start=i)
            for row in batch:
                row["META_ERROR_REASON"] = "LLM_ERROR"
            continue

        for res in llm_results:
            row = idx.get(res.job_id)
            if row is None:
                continue
            if res.match:
                row["matched_company"] = res.matched_company
                row["matched_job_title"] = res.matched_job_title
                row["matched_location"] = res.matched_location
                row["reason"] = res.reason
                row["used_llm"] = True
            else:
                reject(row, "NO_MATCH")

    sli_observe(prev_data, MODULE_NAME, start_time, trace_id)
    return ExecutionResult(
        trace_id=trace_id,
        script_span_id=f"{MODULE_NAME}_{trace_id}",
        data=passed(prev_data),
        artifacts={},
        metrics={},
    )

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Union

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class NoulQuestion(BaseModel):
    instructions: Any
    true: Optional[Any] = None
    false: Optional[Any] = None


class ChoiceQuestion(BaseModel):
    instructions: Any
    options: Dict[str, Any]


class ScoreQuestion(BaseModel):
    instructions: Any
    levels: List[Any]


SystemOneQuestion = Union[NoulQuestion, ChoiceQuestion, ScoreQuestion]


class NoulAnswer(BaseModel):
    probability: float

    @property
    def confidence(self) -> float:
        """How decisive the answer is, on the same scale as the confidence the
        API returns for Choice and Score answers.

        A Noul answer carries no confidence of its own because ``P(no)`` is
        already ``1 - P(yes)``. TypeSafe derives Choice/Score confidence from
        the probability distribution as ``(n * peak - 1) / (n - 1)``; with the
        two outcomes of a Noul that reduces to ``|2p - 1|``: 0 at ``p = 0.5``,
        1 at either extreme, symmetric between yes and no."""
        return abs(2.0 * self.probability - 1.0)


class ChoiceAnswer(BaseModel):
    choice: str
    probabilities: Dict[str, float]
    confidence: float


class ScoreAnswer(BaseModel):
    score: float
    probabilities: Dict[int, float]
    confidence: float

    @property
    def normalized(self) -> float:
        top = max(self.probabilities) if self.probabilities else 0
        return self.score / top if top > 0 else 0.0


class SystemOneAnswers(BaseModel):
    nouls: Dict[str, NoulAnswer] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    choices: Dict[str, ChoiceAnswer] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    scores: Dict[str, ScoreAnswer] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    def min_confidence(self) -> Optional[float]:
        """The least decisive answer in the request, or ``None`` when there
        are no answers. One question near the fence is enough to make an
        aggregate over the request untrustworthy, so the minimum rather than
        the mean is what a confidence gate should look at."""
        values = [a.confidence for a in self.nouls.values()]
        values += [a.confidence for a in self.choices.values()]
        values += [a.confidence for a in self.scores.values()]
        return min(values) if values else None

"""LLM agent: decide which jobs match the recruiter profile (company × title × location)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time

from v2.shared.api_calls.llm import BudgetExceeded, ChoiceQuestion, NoulQuestion, decide
from v2.shared.observability.sli_observe import passed, reject, sli_observe
from v2.shared.patterns.logging import get_logger, log_event
from v2.shared.patterns.worker_runtime import ExecutionResult

MODULE_NAME = "job_matcher__match_jobs"
MODULE_TYPE = "filter"
REJECTION_REASONS = {"NO_MATCH"}
ERROR_REASONS = {"LLM_ERROR"}
WARNING_REASONS: set[str] = set()

_MATCH_THRESHOLD = 0.5


def _job_state(row: dict) -> dict:
    page = row.get("page") or {}
    sj = page.get("structured_job") or {}
    return {
        "company": row.get("resolved_company") or row.get("company") or sj.get("company") or "",
        "title": row.get("resolved_title") or row.get("title") or sj.get("title") or "",
        "location_strings": row.get("location_strings") or [],
        "is_remote": bool(row.get("is_remote_hint")),
        "title_tag": (page.get("title_tag") or "")[:120],
        "url": (row.get("source_url") or "")[:100],
    }


def _build_questions(companies: list[str], titles: list[str], locations: list[dict]) -> dict:
    questions: dict = {}

    # Company: one ChoiceQuestion; options keyed by index string
    options = {str(i): name for i, name in enumerate(companies)}
    options["__none__"] = "None — no target company matches"
    questions["company"] = ChoiceQuestion(
        instructions=(
            "Which target company does this job belong to? "
            "Ignore case, punctuation, legal suffixes (Ltd, plc, Group, Holdings, Corp, UK), "
            "and a leading 'The'. Consider the company name in title_tag, url, and title."
        ),
        options=options,
    )

    # Titles: one NoulQuestion per target title
    for i, title in enumerate(titles):
        questions[f"title_{i}"] = NoulQuestion(
            instructions=(
                f"Does the job title contain every word from '{title}'? "
                "Word order doesn't matter; ignore case and punctuation; treat trailing 's' as plural."
            ),
            true=f"Job title matches '{title}'",
            false=f"Job title does NOT match '{title}'",
        )

    # Locations: one NoulQuestion per target location
    for i, loc in enumerate(locations):
        name = loc["name"]
        loc_type = loc.get("type", "")
        includes = loc.get("includes") or []
        country = loc.get("country", "United Kingdom")
        if loc_type == "remote":
            instruction = (
                f"Is this job declared as remote or home-based work in {country} ('{name}')?"
            )
        else:
            inc_str = f" Includes: {', '.join(includes)}." if includes else ""
            instruction = (
                f"Is this job located in '{name}' ({loc_type}) in {country}?{inc_str}"
            )
        questions[f"loc_{i}"] = NoulQuestion(
            instructions=instruction,
            true=f"Job is in '{name}'",
            false=f"Job is NOT in '{name}'",
        )

    return questions


def main(context: dict, prev_data: list[dict]) -> ExecutionResult:
    trace_id: str = context.get("trace_id") or ""
    start_time = time.time()
    logger = get_logger(MODULE_NAME)

    profile = context["profile"]
    companies = [c["name"] if isinstance(c, dict) else c for c in profile.get("companies") or []]
    titles = profile.get("titles") or []
    locations = profile.get("locations") or []

    questions = _build_questions(companies, titles, locations)

    for row in prev_data:
        try:
            answers = decide(_job_state(row), questions, purpose="job_matching")
        except BudgetExceeded:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            log_event(logger, "error", "llm_job_failed", trace_id, error=str(exc), job_id=row.get("job_id"))
            row["META_ERROR_REASON"] = "LLM_ERROR"
            continue

        # Company
        company_ans = answers.choices.get("company")
        if not company_ans or company_ans.choice == "__none__":
            reject(row, "NO_MATCH")
            continue
        try:
            matched_company = companies[int(company_ans.choice)]
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            reject(row, "NO_MATCH")
            continue

        # Titles — collect ALL matches above threshold
        matched_titles = [
            titles[i]
            for i in range(len(titles))
            if (a := answers.nouls.get(f"title_{i}")) and a.probability > _MATCH_THRESHOLD
        ]
        if not matched_titles:
            reject(row, "NO_MATCH")
            continue

        # Locations — collect ALL matches above threshold
        matched_locs = [
            locations[i]["name"]
            for i in range(len(locations))
            if (a := answers.nouls.get(f"loc_{i}")) and a.probability > _MATCH_THRESHOLD
        ]
        if not matched_locs:
            reject(row, "NO_MATCH")
            continue

        row["matched_company"] = matched_company
        row["matched_job_title"] = matched_titles
        row["matched_location"] = matched_locs
        row["reason"] = (
            f"jev: company={matched_company}, "
            f"titles={matched_titles}, locations={matched_locs}"
        )
        row["used_llm"] = True

    sli_observe(prev_data, MODULE_NAME, start_time, trace_id)
    return ExecutionResult(
        trace_id=trace_id,
        script_span_id=f"{MODULE_NAME}_{trace_id}",
        data=passed(prev_data),
        artifacts={},
        metrics={},
    )

        f"TARGET COMPANIES ({len(companies)}):\n"

        + f"\n\nTARGET JOB TITLES ({len(titles)}):\n"
        + ", ".join(str(t) for t in titles)
        + f"\n\nTARGET LOCATIONS ({len(locs)}):\n"
        + "\n".join(loc_lines)
    )


def _job_prompt(row: dict) -> dict:
    page = row.get("page") or {}
    sj = page.get("structured_job") or {}
    return {
        "job_id": row.get("job_id", ""),
        "company": row.get("resolved_company") or row.get("company") or sj.get("company") or "",
        "title": row.get("resolved_title") or row.get("title") or sj.get("title") or "",
        "location_strings": row.get("location_strings") or [],
        "is_remote": bool(row.get("is_remote_hint")),
        "title_tag": (page.get("title_tag") or "")[:120],
    }


def _build_prompt(profile_text: str, jobs: list[dict]) -> str:
    return f"""You are a job matching assistant. Evaluate each job against the recruiter's profile.
            A job MATCHES only when ALL THREE pass:
            1. COMPANY: The company on the job page is one of the target companies.
            Match ignores case, punctuation, legal suffixes (Ltd, plc, Group, Holdings, Corp, UK), and a leading "The".
            2. TITLE: Every word from a target job title appears in the job title
            (any order, case-insensitive; treat trailing "s" as plural).
            3. LOCATION: Job location is in one of the target locations.
            - city/sub_region: job must be in that city or any of its includes list.
            - remote: job must declare remote/home-based work.
            - Jobs in a different country never match.

            {profile_text}

            JOBS TO EVALUATE:
            {json.dumps(jobs, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

            For each job return:
            - job_id: same as input
            - match: true if all three pass, false otherwise
            - matched_company: the matching profile company name (empty string if no match)
            - matched_job_title: list of ALL matching profile titles (empty if no match)
            - matched_location: list of ALL matching profile location names (empty if no match)
            - reason: one sentence explaining the decision"""


def main(context: dict, prev_data: list[dict]) -> ExecutionResult:
    trace_id: str = context.get("trace_id") or ""
    start_time = time.time()
    logger = get_logger(MODULE_NAME)

    profile = context["profile"]
    profile_text = _profile_prompt(profile)

    idx: dict[str, dict] = {r["job_id"]: r for r in prev_data}

    for i in range(0, len(prev_data), BATCH_SIZE):
        batch = prev_data[i : i + BATCH_SIZE]
        try:
            prompt = _build_prompt(profile_text, [_job_prompt(r) for r in batch])
            llm_results = ask_pydantic(prompt, _BatchResults, purpose="job_matching").results
        except Exception as exc:
            log_event(logger, "error", "llm_batch_failed", trace_id, error=str(exc), batch_start=i)
            for row in batch:
                row["META_ERROR_REASON"] = "LLM_ERROR"
            continue

        for res in llm_results:
            row = idx.get(res.job_id)
            if row is None:
                continue
            if res.match:
                row["matched_company"] = res.matched_company
                row["matched_job_title"] = res.matched_job_title
                row["matched_location"] = res.matched_location
                row["reason"] = res.reason
                row["used_llm"] = True
            else:
                reject(row, "NO_MATCH")

    sli_observe(prev_data, MODULE_NAME, start_time, trace_id)
    return ExecutionResult(
        trace_id=trace_id,
        script_span_id=f"{MODULE_NAME}_{trace_id}",
        data=passed(prev_data),
        artifacts={},
        metrics={},
    )

::

    import ai
    import pydantic

                instructions="Is the customer requesting a refund?",
            ),
        ),
        output_type=Answers,
    )
    result.value.requests_refund
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Annotated, Any, Literal, TypedDict, overload

import pydantic

from ... import experimental_telemetry as telemetry
from .. import items

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from ...models.core import model as model_


type EvaluationInput = (
    str | dict[str, pydantic.JsonValue] | list[pydantic.JsonValue]
)


class NoulCriteria(TypedDict, total=False):
    """Optional descriptions of when a Noul answer is true or false."""

    true: EvaluationInput | None
    false: EvaluationInput | None


_QUESTION_CONFIG = pydantic.ConfigDict(
    allow_inf_nan=False,
    extra="forbid",
    frozen=True,
    strict=True,
)


class ChoiceQuestion(pydantic.BaseModel):
    """Choose one key from a nonempty map of options."""

    instructions: EvaluationInput
    criteria: Annotated[
        dict[str, EvaluationInput | None],
        pydantic.Field(min_length=1),
    ]
    type: Literal["choice"] = "choice"

    model_config = _QUESTION_CONFIG


class ScoreQuestion(pydantic.BaseModel):
    """Score state against at least two ordered rubric levels."""

    instructions: EvaluationInput
    criteria: Annotated[
        list[EvaluationInput | None],
        pydantic.Field(min_length=2),
    ]
    type: Literal["score"] = "score"

    model_config = _QUESTION_CONFIG


class NoulQuestion(pydantic.BaseModel):
    """Estimate the probability that a statement about state is true."""

    instructions: EvaluationInput
    criteria: NoulCriteria | None = None
    type: Literal["noul"] = "noul"

    model_config = _QUESTION_CONFIG


Probability = Annotated[
    pydantic.StrictFloat,
    pydantic.Field(ge=0, le=1, allow_inf_nan=False),
]
ScoreValue = Annotated[
    pydantic.StrictFloat,
    pydantic.Field(allow_inf_nan=False),
]


class ChoiceAnswer(pydantic.BaseModel):
    """Selected choice and its optional complete probability distribution."""

    type: Literal["choice"] = "choice"
    choice: str
    probabilities: dict[str, Probability] | None = None
    confidence: Probability | None = None

    model_config = pydantic.ConfigDict(frozen=True)


class ScoreAnswer(pydantic.BaseModel):
    """Fractional rubric score and its optional probability distribution."""

    type: Literal["score"] = "score"
    score: ScoreValue
    probabilities: dict[str, Probability] | None = None
    confidence: Probability | None = None

    model_config = pydantic.ConfigDict(frozen=True)


class NoulAnswer(pydantic.BaseModel):
    """Model-estimated probability that the answer is true."""

    type: Literal["noul"] = "noul"
    noul: Probability

    model_config = pydantic.ConfigDict(frozen=True)


@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True)
class EvaluationParams:
    """Parameters for evaluation."""

    provider_options: Mapping[str, Any] = dataclasses.field(
        default_factory=dict
    )
    """Provider-specific options, keyed by provider name."""


type _Question = ChoiceQuestion | ScoreQuestion | NoulQuestion
type _Answer = ChoiceAnswer | ScoreAnswer | NoulAnswer

_QUESTION_TYPES = (ChoiceQuestion, ScoreQuestion, NoulQuestion)
_ANSWER_TYPES: dict[type[_Question], type[pydantic.BaseModel]] = {
    ChoiceQuestion: ChoiceAnswer,
    ScoreQuestion: ScoreAnswer,
    NoulQuestion: NoulAnswer,
}
_INPUT_ADAPTER: pydantic.TypeAdapter[EvaluationInput] = pydantic.TypeAdapter(
    EvaluationInput,

)


@overload

"""The ONE way this codebase calls an LLM — TypeSafe AI jev via Vercel AI Gateway.

Usage:
    from v2.shared.api_calls.llm import decide, NoulQuestion, ChoiceQuestion, BudgetExceeded

    answers = decide(
        state={"title": "Controls Engineer", "company": "Siemens Energy", ...},
        questions={
            "company_match": NoulQuestion(
                instructions="Does this job belong to one of the target companies?",
                criteria={"true": "Company matches", "false": "Company does not match"},
            ),
            "location": ChoiceQuestion(
                instructions="Which location?",
                criteria={"wigan": "Wigan", "none": "None"},
            ),
        },
        purpose="job_matching",
    )
    answers["company_match"].noul   # float [0, 1] — probability of True
    answers["location"].choice      # e.g. "wigan"

Provider: typesafe-ai/jev via Vercel AI Gateway (JEV_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY in .env → AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY).
Every call is logged to runs/<run>/llm_calls.jsonl (tokens, GBP cost, purpose).
Hard stop at £3.00 (BudgetExceeded raised before sending).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import os
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import ai
from ai.ops.experimental import (  # re-exported for callers
    ChoiceAnswer,
    ChoiceQuestion,
    NoulAnswer,
    NoulQuestion,
    ScoreAnswer,
    ScoreQuestion,
    evaluate,
)

BUDGET_GBP = 3.00
USD_TO_GBP = 0.79
_JEV_INPUT_PRICE_USD_PER_M = 0.042  # output tokens are free

_MODEL_ID = "typesafe-ai/jev"

_run_dir: Path | None = None
_budget_lock = threading.Lock()
_model: Any = None


class BudgetExceeded(RuntimeError):
    """The £3.00 hard stop would be passed. Nothing was sent."""


def start_run(run_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Called by the handler: this run's calls are logged in run_dir/llm_calls.jsonl."""
    global _run_dir
    _run_dir = run_dir


def _runs_root() -> Path:
    return Path(os.environ.get("ILLUMINI_RUNS_DIR", "runs"))


def spent_gbp() -> float:
    """Total spend so far, across every run folder."""
    total = 0.0
    for ledger in _runs_root().glob("*/llm_calls.jsonl"):
        with ledger.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
            total += sum(json.loads(line)["cost_gbp"] for line in f if line.strip())
    return total


def _load_env(path: Path = Path(".env")) -> None:
    if path.exists():
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
            if sep and not key.strip().startswith("#"):
                os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip('"'))


def _ensure_gateway_key() -> None:
    _load_env()
    jev_key = os.environ.get("JEV_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY", "")
    if not jev_key:
        raise RuntimeError("No jev key: set JEV_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_KEY in .env")
    os.environ.setdefault("AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY", jev_key)


def _get_model() -> Any:
    global _model
    if _model is None:
        _ensure_gateway_key()
        _model = ai.get_model(_MODEL_ID)
    return _model


def _cost_gbp(input_tokens: int) -> float:
    return input_tokens * _JEV_INPUT_PRICE_USD_PER_M / 1_000_000 * USD_TO_GBP


def _estimate_tokens(state: dict, questions: dict) -> int:
    state_chars = sum(len(str(v)) for v in state.values())
    question_chars = sum(len(str(q)) for q in questions.values())
    return (state_chars + question_chars) // 4


def _guard(estimated_tokens: int) -> float:
    total = spent_gbp()
    worst = _cost_gbp(estimated_tokens)
    if total + worst > BUDGET_GBP:
        raise BudgetExceeded(
            f"LLM budget: £{total:.4f} spent, this call ~£{worst:.4f}, cap £{BUDGET_GBP:.2f}"
        )
    return total


async def _evaluate_async(state: dict, questions: dict) -> tuple[dict, int]:
    item = await evaluate(_get_model(), state, questions)
    input_tokens = item.usage.input_tokens if item.usage else 0
    return item.value, input_tokens


def decide(
    state: dict[str, Any],
    questions: dict[str, NoulQuestion | ChoiceQuestion | ScoreQuestion],
    purpose: str = "",
) -> dict[str, NoulAnswer | ChoiceAnswer | ScoreAnswer]:
    """Ask jev to answer structured questions about `state`.

    answers["key"].noul    — NoulAnswer: probability float [0, 1]
    answers["key"].choice  — ChoiceAnswer: chosen option key string
    answers["key"].score   — ScoreAnswer: float score
    """
    estimated = _estimate_tokens(state, questions)
    with _budget_lock:
        total = _guard(estimated)

    started = time.time()
    answers, input_tokens = asyncio.run(_evaluate_async(state, questions))
    cost = _cost_gbp(input_tokens)

    rd = _run_dir or (_runs_root() / time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", time.gmtime(started)))
    rd.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with _budget_lock:
        with (rd / "llm_calls.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(
                json.dumps({
                    "ts": round(started, 3),
                    "provider": "jev",
                    "model": _MODEL_ID,
                    "purpose": purpose,
                    "input_tokens": input_tokens,
                    "output_tokens": 0,
                    "cost_gbp": round(cost, 6),
                    "total_gbp": round(total + cost, 6),
                    "latency_ms": round((time.time() - started) * 1000),
                }) + "\n"
            )
    return answers
